item.title: Whiskers 0.8.31
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.31

### Licensing & Free Tier

  • Added License settings to activate premium and view remaining free dictation time
  • Improved in-app messages when you reach free limits, with quick access to purchase or enter a license key
  • Enforced free-plan usage limits for bulk transcription

    • ### Dictation & Setup

  • Improved hotkey responsiveness and reliability
  • Added clearer guidance when microphone access, accessibility access, or model setup is required

    • ### Improvements

  • Improved bulk transcription model availability with automatic fallback when the selected model is unavailable

    • ### Bug Fixes

  • Fixed edge cases where bulk transcription could end up using an unready model
